provider_source_scope: Scientific/export sources and stability inventory match the commit; unrelated benchmark tooling changes are excluded.
verification: Source inspection only, not runtime or installed qualification.
scope: Exports of seven tool modules, h5msm and nine interaction-family modules; root aliases and native methods are accounted for separately.

workflows.contract: Extend existing hierarchy/context inspection with composition and readable labels. Attribute availability is not proof of chemical completeness; preserve group terminology.

workflows.task_and_placement: Recognize inputs and composition / loading and Contents
workflows.contract: Reusable preflight and targeted summaries, not six new buttons. Preserve public return/diagnostic contracts.
Existing Viewer selection owners remain canonical. Preserve state, frame, syntax and element-level semantics; active selection and reviewed edit target remain distinct.

workflows.task_and_placement: Convert/save and review loss / Save & Export
workflows.contract: Add molecular writer workflow; retain structured preflight evidence. Input format support does not imply output support; actual writers and published versions remain to qualify.

workflows.task_and_placement: Remove atoms or retain an atom selection / System Edit
workflows.contract: General operations with reusable active/saved/query, source/region, chain/group, category and index/expression targets; water removal only prefills that selection. Reuse existing extraction and public Viewer integration, qualifying correspondence/recovery instead of adding methods per recipe. The `remove` signature advertises `in_place=True`, but its body ignores the flag (uibcdf/molsysmt#406); ownership/remapping must be qualified.
Reuse `view.load`; preserve current source regions and first/current-box contracts. `add` has in-place and attribute-intersection policies; review dropped attributes and generated identities.

workflows.task_and_placement: Append or combine observations / System Load
workflows.contract: Reuse current load modes. Compatible atom identity/order, ordered frames, times and attribute policy stay explicit; no automatic alignment or broadcasting.

workflows.task_and_placement: Work on an independent copy / System workflow or Python tools
workflows.contract: Existing Viewer copy tool uses public `msm.copy`. Complete-system independent-edit/revision receiving remains distinct from source copy support and published qualification.

workflows.task_and_placement: Compare systems or populations / System comparison, placement to validate
workflows.contract: Provide readable differences only for supported comparison attributes; identify both systems/populations and correspondence rather than assuming equal counts imply identity.
Existing provider-to-Viewer entry route; no recursive Studio button that launches the same view without a user task.
Supports bounded calculations where the operation actually supports iteration. Not a standalone panel, universal out-of-core guarantee or replacement for preserved structure semantics.

workflows.task_and_placement: Assign explicit attributes / canonical owning workflows
workflows.contract: Use through typed operations such as existing coordinate/box assignment; design supported metadata edits by field. No generic raw setter grid or GUI-only mutation path.
Graph/table and source-atom highlighting; removing graph edges for partition analysis does not remove molecular bonds. A NetworkX graph is not itself a persisted scene object.
Retain selected chemical state, ring definition and connectivity completeness assumptions; a minimum cycle basis is not a list of every possible cycle.

workflows.task_and_placement: Inspect torsions and rigid fragments / Topology Connectivity
workflows.contract: Preserve classification method, explicit cuts and atom quartets. Deriving a fragment is not rotating it; link to Structure torsion editing.

workflows.task_and_placement: Find chemical substructures / Topology or Selections shortcut
workflows.contract: SMARTS, graph completeness and match cap are explicit; preserve match populations and source indices. One canonical operation may have selection-entry links.
Explicit reference input/selection and Biopython branch qualification; sequence alignment is distinct from coordinate superposition.
Preserve selected and full chemical context, chemical states, anchors/candidate maps and bounded search scope. Mapping persistence and reuse require their source validity contract.
Existing scene measures and series remain canonical; extend supported batch analysis without replacing anchored measurement semantics. Keep atom endpoints/centers, pairs, PBC and units explicit.
Preserve two populations, pair/group reduction and returned indices; default PBC differs from ordinary distance calls.

workflows.task_and_placement: Inspect centers, vectors and planes / Structure Analyze
workflows.contract: Weights, geometric versus mass centers and plane fit definition are explicit. Optional shapes represent results without pretending to be detectors or changing coordinates.

workflows.task_and_placement: Find neighbors or geometric contacts / Structure Analyze; Selections links
workflows.contract: Preserve cutoff/count, pairs, PBC and center modes. A geometric contact matrix is not a typed chemical Interactions result; an adapter needs a separate contract.
Explicit moving/reference populations, frames, vectors/matrices and units; preserve method-specific scope. Camera center/rotation is separate; reflection can change handedness.
Explicit quartets, movable blocks, angular units and frames. Show which atoms move; do not conflate absolute target with angular increment.

workflows.task_and_placement: Analyze size and fluctuations / Structure Analyze
workflows.contract: Rg is per observation; RMSF reduces over a population of structures. Weights and alignment preparation are explicit; no unrequested fitting.
Preserve MDTraj engine, simplified/full labels, group/frame axes and availability. Do not silently replace imported or Mol* visual assignments.
Distinguish positional RMSD from optimal-superposition RMSD; identify atom correspondence and reference frame. Calculating fitted RMSD does not apply a coordinate fit.
Distinguish fitting and moved populations, explicit reference, optional sequence alignment and engine parameters; commit actual coordinate edits with recovery.

workflows.task_and_placement: Analyze principal axes or PCA / Structure Analyze
workflows.contract: Inertia/geometric axes and Cartesian covariance PCA are different. PCA returns eigenvectors/eigenvalues, not trajectory projections; estimate covariance/output size before running.
Explicit source axes/population, target axes, optional centering and frames; not a camera orientation tool.

workflows.task_and_placement: Compare chemically equivalent poses / Structure Analyze
workflows.contract: Requires valid chemical correspondences and explicit reference/state. Positional corrected RMSD does not fit, reflect or apply MIC automatically; retain constrained search scope and original producer data.
Reuse box inspection with explicit matrix/length/angle/volume units. Distinguish missing cell from zero/invalid cell and preserve structure alignment.

workflows.task_and_placement: Construct and assign a cell / proposed add-on Structure PBC
workflows.contract: Construction returns a box; scientific assignment belongs to MolSysMT. Qualify explicit reconciliation/coordinated tool integration before any setter migration. Preserve units, source/structure selection, validation and cell-edge display.
Keep box origin, MIC origin, compact grouping and structure scope distinct. These edit molecular coordinates; preserve identities and invalidate affected geometry evidence.
State the provider definition: tabulated/pH/force-field charge is not automatically an explicit formal or partial charge. Preserve element aggregation and units.
Named radius/type/scale definitions and missing entries are visible; a value lookup does not assign a force field or alter the rendered atomic radii implicitly.

These include tabulated amino-acid reference scales, not all coordinate-based observables. In particular volume is Grantham side-chain scale and buried area/fraction are reference tables; labels/units must say so.

Coordinate-based SASA with explicit engine, probe radius, sphere samples, group aggregation and frames. Native occlusion uses the full input system before filtering selected outputs; isolated-component SASA needs an explicit different input. Keep this separate from tabulated surface area.

workflows.task_and_placement: Inspect chemically defined sites / Properties; Interactions links
workflows.contract: Retain ordered participants, chemical evidence, full-graph context, state and matching limits. A recognized site is not an interaction occurrence. Reuse tools across consumers.
Separate perception from stored flags; declared stereo versus coordinate-derived CIP and RDKit availability are explicit. Do not silently apply perceived assignments.

workflows.task_and_placement: Inspect chemical readiness / Build Inspect, Topology Chemistry link
workflows.contract: Distinguish explicit indexed H, stored virtual H and unassessed chemistry. Readiness assesses fields/coverage, not universal validity; method-specific single-frame limits remain visible.

workflows.task_and_placement: Calculate charges and atom types / Properties
workflows.contract: Explicit method/typing scheme, state, full-graph admission, optional force field/water model and returned report. Calculating labels/charges is separate from assigning them.

workflows.task_and_placement: Assess a declared template / Build Inspect
workflows.contract: Explicit template, exhaustive atom correspondence, provenance and connectivity policy; no identity inferred from equal counts or atom names.
Produce independent candidates, retain assignment evidence and invalidate affected chemistry/geometry results. Normalization uses declared aromaticity, not automatic perception.

workflows.task_and_placement: Construct peptide chemical template / Build Construct
workflows.contract: Explicit group sequence, terminal states and disulfide group pairs. A heavy-atom chemical template is not a completed 3D peptide; link to assessment/application workflows.

Reports, source groups and proposed fixes. Reference sequence/template availability and original file metadata matter. Solvation is a water-density/box heuristic, not proof of equilibration; provider names containing residue need user-facing group wording where appropriate.

Distinguish template candidates, backbone distance candidates and S–S candidates. Preserve frames/PBC/evidence; none proves that a covalent bond exists. Disulfide visualization reuses Interactions when appropriate.

workflows.task_and_placement: Infer or add connectivity / Build Repair
workflows.contract: Explicit method/template and distance policies; review proposed bonds. Legacy add may be in-place; protect source and use one chemical-state authority.

workflows.task_and_placement: Complete heavy atoms and termini / Build Repair
workflows.contract: Supported group templates/engines, caps, geometry and attribute retention are explicit. Template files existing on disk do not establish arbitrary group reconstruction support.

workflows.task_and_placement: Place H or reconcile protonation / Build Repair
workflows.contract: Separate pH/template rules from fixed-state RDKit H placement; existing H removal is an explicit reconciliation operation. Honor single-state/frame and attribute-policy limits, engine selection and retained preparation evidence.

workflows.task_and_placement: Attach declared terminal atoms / Build Construct
workflows.contract: Explicit parent mapping, new atom declarations and coordinates; added-atom maps and chemical/preparation history need provider-contract receiving. Not arbitrary de novo ligand generation.
Explicit occupancy/location policy and selected structures, with atom-axis consequences and recovery. Show unavailable source alternate-site information honestly.
Explicit target group indices/names and replacement; native versus PDBFixer reconstruction limits require qualification. Preserve sequence and atom mapping without promising arbitrary chemistry.

Use actual source assembly operators and selected frames. Heterogeneous per-operator chain sets are unsupported in the inspected contract; generated copies/source identities and repeated chain labels require review.

workflows.task_and_placement: Build a peptide or water box / Build Construct
workflows.contract: Sequence input versus declared periodic cell, actual output form and supported models are explicit. Building output does not automatically replace the current system; choose add/replace through the canonical load/edit owner.

workflows.task_and_placement: Solvate or remove overlaps / Build Construct or Repair
workflows.contract: Explicit solvent/ions, box/model/clearance, neutrality/count/concentration and engine; overlap removal uses selected populations, one-frame geometry and molecule-level removal. Review generated/deleted atoms before commit.

workflows.task_and_placement: Assign charges or atom types / Build Repair
workflows.contract: Apply complete validated assignments to a detached system with declared state. Do not turn a partial calculation selection into a partly assigned current system silently.

workflows.task_and_placement: Stage explicit molecular construction / Build Construct
workflows.contract: Public builder owns atom/group/bond/parent construction; independent staging and build validation precede Viewer commit. The builder is not a drop-in holder for all analyses, mechanics and state/structure links.
Legacy rule tools remain Python APIs; expose readable scientific criteria where useful, not mutable global rule editing as an implicit calculation default.

workflows.task_and_placement: Inspect H-bond sites and directions / Interactions or Properties link
workflows.contract: Preserve state, recognition method, ideal versus observed geometry, ordered roles, matching limits and PBC. A direction glyph is not proof of a detected bond.

Existing `view.interactions.hbonds.get_hbonds` and method-specific public routes retain explicit Viewer defaults and provider method/profile identity. Preserve optional legacy output types in Python; Studio consumes typed analyses rather than inventing new tuples.
Existing family adapter; candidate geometry is distinct from covalent assignment in Build.
Existing adapter; explicit formal-charge centers and distance threshold, not electrostatic energy or implicit assignment of protonation.
Existing adapter; retain profile, ring/plane definition, geometry thresholds, planarity and compound participants.
Existing adapter; formal cation identity, declared aromatic rings, profile and distance/angle/offset criteria remain explicit.
Existing adapter; preserve donor/halogen/acceptor/reference roles and both angular criteria, not just a connecting line.
Existing adapter; chemical site recognition plus distance observations, not hydrophobic free energy.
Existing adapter; geometric candidates retain actual chemical recognition limits and do not change covalent topology.
Existing adapter; preserve order, underlying H-bond method/profile, all leg participants, coverage and images.
Reuse native loading and analysis import. Partial domains do not imply renderable coordinates or authenticated source identity.
Recommended molecular format and existing Interactions save owner. Preserve supported states/structures/analyses and explicit identity links; mechanics has no 0.5 layer.

workflows.task_and_placement: Append file structures / file-management task, placement to review
workflows.contract: Mutates an external file, not just the view. Needs separate overwrite/recovery policy; ordinary molecular Undo cannot silently claim to reverse external filesystem effects. No deferral is declared here.

workflows.task_and_placement: Migrate legacy files / loading or save conversion
workflows.contract: Explicit migration output and loss/compatibility report; do not rewrite caller files as a side effect of opening them. Reuse one operation for equivalent migration aliases.
OpenMM parameterization, solvent/force-field/platform and selection semantics need a complete workflow. Preserve energy definition and units; coordinates alone are insufficient.

workflows.task_and_placement: Inspect forces and degrees of freedom / placement to validate
workflows.contract: Explicit parameterization, atom/structure support, force/vector units and constraints. Provider branch support must be qualified, not inferred from a generic signature.

workflows.task_and_placement: Choose engine force-field setup / setup support
workflows.contract: Engine-specific force-field representation, not a portable scientific result or automatic complete parameterization.

workflows.task_and_placement: Minimize energy / preparation workflow, placement to validate
workflows.contract: Explicit engine/method/platform, starting parameterized state, retained outcome and recoverable coordinate edit. No automatic minimization after another operation.

qualification_limits: Defaults are source syntax, not proof of engine/branch availability.
Return text is provider documentation, not an executed observation.
New Viewer orchestration, persistence and recovery remain design work.

design_basis.capability_unit: General operation + explicit selections/inputs + operation-specific parameters
design_basis.python: Public MolSysMT composition with general public Viewer integration/domain APIs; qualify required extensions and additional independently useful view-aware tools.
design_basis.private: Studio form adapters and shared coordination in the existing reconciliation/history/transport owners.
design_basis.shortcuts: Visible argument presets for the same operation; no hidden scientific steps.
design_basis.workflow_ids: Existing IDs group related operations and acceptance scenarios; they do not require canned workflows or public wrappers per scenario.
design_basis.linked_system_edits: Explicit qualified reconciliation or coordinated integrated-tool operations. The general observer request in uibcdf/molsysmt#413 is withdrawn; no new provider deliverable is currently required under that issue.
design_basis.molecular_setters: Scientific assignment belongs to MolSysMT. Retire redundant Viewer setters such as set_box only after a qualified general route and compatibility migration; runtime unchanged during planning.
design_basis.independent_outputs: Independent returned molecular systems are incorporated explicitly, without replacing the current view automatically.
design_basis.raw_writes: No universal observation of writable arrays/tables or uncoordinated aliases; explicit advanced responsibilities remain.
design_basis.product_boundary: Core visualization/exploration includes qualified calculations for visual content; additional molecular tools belong to add-on/scientific interfaces. Normative: core_and_addon_boundary.md.
design_basis.placement_status: Earlier task_and_placement values are comparison proposals requiring reassessment after the 2026-10-22 core/add-on decision; scientific source snapshot and counts remain fixed.
